act_on_findings: The management field is each finding's persisted scan state: 'active' findings can be fixed or ignored (manage_security_finding / ignore_security_finding); 'ignored_by_user' findings were dismissed by the user — do not fix, re-propose, or re-report them; 'not_persisted' findings exist only in this scan and cannot be ignored or marked fixed — fix real issues in code and rescan to confirm; leave intentional ones as they are (a later persisted scan records them, after which they can be ignored).
